2645-3181-3430-3664.easyPrerequisites: Krosan Restorer doesn't have summoning sickness.
2645-3181-3430-3664.description:
Activate Lotus Field by tapping it, adding nine mana of any color due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Krosan Restorer by tapping it, untapping Lotus Field
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Krosan Restorer.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

2169-2981-4694-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
2169-2981-4694-7306.description:
Activate Zameck Guildmage's first ability by paying {U}{G}, causing each creature you control to enter with an additional +1/+1 counter this turn.
Activate Megatog by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Zameck Guildmage.
Resolve the Megatog ability, giving it +3/+3 and trample until end of turn.
Repeat from step 2.

728-3249-4242-6723.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-4242-6723.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Su-Chi, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Su-Chi dies, it triggers, adding mana equal to its casting cost.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from A Realm Reborn by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Su-Chi from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Su-Chi from your graveyard by paying its casting cost.
Repeat.

5972-6054-8095.notablePrerequisites:
You control an Aura that is attached to another creature you control.
You control at least one additional creature beyond the creature that has the Aura attached.
5972-6054-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing another creature that has an Aura attached to it.
When the creature dies, Cass triggers, returning an Aura that was attached to the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
When the Aura enters the battlefield, Gremlin Tamer triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

2111-5315-6792.description:
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Wingrattle Scarecrow
When Wingrattle Scarecrow dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Wingrattle Scarecrow enters, Mm'menon triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Wingrattle Scarecrow
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability.
Repeat.

589-2428-7743.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
589-2428-7743.description:
Gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fathom Mage.
Fathom Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Horizon Chimera triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1394-2034-2060-7038-7704.description:
Play Power Depot, which will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Cast Toph either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Toph enters, it triggers, earthbending Power Depot and putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Power Depot equal to the mana spent to cast Toph, increased by Doc Samson.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Power Depot.
When Power Depot dies, its modular ability and Toph trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting the +1/+1 counters that were on Power Depot onto Crystalline Crawler, increased by Doc Samson.
Resolve the Toph trigger, returning Power Depot from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped. Power Depot will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Toph. Choose to return Toph from your graveyard to the command zone.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {R/G}.
Repeat step 9 until you have enough mana to cast Toph.
Repeat from step 2.

4390-5078-5465-6757-7633.easyPrerequisites: You control two other untapped artifacts.
4390-5078-5465-6757-7633.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Activate Meria's second ability by tapping two artifacts, exiling Sensei's Divining Top with the ability to play it until end of turn.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from exile by paying {0} due to Doc Aurlock.
Ravenous Robots triggers, creating a 1/1 Robot artifact creature token.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Weapons Manufacturing triggers, creating a Munitions token.
Repeat.

uses.n: Emeritus of Truce // Swords to Plowshares

1170-2642-4050-7577.notablePrerequisites: An opponent controls at least as many creatures as you do.
1170-2642-4050-7577.description:
Cast a copy of the prepared spell by paying its mana cost.
When you cast that spell, Displacer Kitten and Dovescape trigger.
Resolve the Dovescape trigger, countering the prepared spell and creating a number of 1/1 flying Bird creature tokens equal to its mana value.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking Emeritus of Truce.
When Emeritus of Truce enters, it triggers, causing a player to create a 1/1 flying Inkling token and becoming prepared.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Bird token, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat step 5 until you have enough mana to cast the prepared spell.
Repeat

549-3259-4478-5953.easyPrerequisites: Breath of Fury attached to a creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness
549-3259-4478-5953.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
549-3259-4478-5953.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury and Aya of Alexandria trigger.
Resolve the Aya of Alexandria trigger, creating a 1/1 Assassin creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Assassin token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2961-3175-3967.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, False Demise triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning False Demise from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

413-6972-7233.easyPrerequisites: Instant and sorcery cards in your graveyard have total mana value 2 or greater.
413-6972-7233.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Inferno Project.
When Inferno Project dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
When Inferno Project enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

3621-5147-7282.description:
Activate Chrome Dome by paying {5}, creating a token copy of Su-Chi Cave Guard with haste.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the Su-Chi Cave Guard token.
When the Su-Chi Cave Guard token dies, it triggers, adding eight {C}.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.
3621-5147-7282.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can just do step 1 repeatedly.

640-3944-5220-6900.description:
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it.
When Blood Pet dies, Mortuary and Dross Harvester trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Blood Pet from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Dross Harvester trigger, causing you to gain 2 life
Resolve the Blood Pet ability.
Cast Blood Pet from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

5968-6798-6888.description:
Cast Traveling Plague by paying {3}{B}{B}, attaching it to another creature you control.
When Traveling Plague enters, Ghostly Dancers triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the creature Traveling Plague is attached to.
When the creature dies, Traveling Plague triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the token created in step 2.
When Traveling Plague enters, Ghostly Dancers triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat from step 3.

509-1267-2003-5143.manaNeeded: {1}{U}{R} available the first turn, with {4} each even-numbered extra turn
509-1267-2003-5143.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
509-1267-2003-5143.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Medomai the Ageless.
Medomai the Ageless triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Idris by paying {1}{U}{R}.
When Idris enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Medomai the Ageless until Idris leaves the battlefield.
Move to your extra turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Idris's vanishing ability triggers, removing a time counter from it.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Idris.
Idris triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat from step 4 one additional time.
Activate Contagion Engine by paying {4} and tapping it, putting two time counters on Idris.
Repeat from step 7.

5078-6757-6766.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Diving Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters the battlefield, Weapons Manufacturing triggers, creating a Munitions token.
Activate the Munitions token by tapping it, adding {U} that can only be spent to cast spells from anywhere except your hand.
Repeat.

1231-4826-5686-6644.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Ancient Adamantoise.
When Ancient Adamantoise dies, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Gravewaker by paying {5}{B}{B}, returning Ancient Adamantoise from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Ancient Adamantoise trigger, creating ten Treasure tokens that enter untapped due to Archelos.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate seven Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

659-5200-5231.easyPrerequisites:
Krenko, Mob Boss does not have summoning sickness.
Sword of the Paruns attached to Krenko.
659-5200-5231.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Goblins.
659-5200-5231.description:
Activate Krenko by tapping it, creating at least three 1/1 Goblin creature tokens.
Activate Thermopod three times by sacrificing three Goblin tokens, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping Krenko.
Repeat.
659-5200-5231.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may attach Sword of the Paruns to any other creature(s) to untap them.

372-1567-4477.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Momentary Blink exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-1567-4477.description:
Cast Momentary Blink by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Greenwarden of Murasa and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Greenwarden of Murasa trigger.
Resolve the Greenwarden of Murasa trigger, returning Momentary Blink from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Momentary Blink.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Greenwarden of Murasa and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

511-817-1887-2557-4050.description:
Activate Fungal Bloom by paying {G}{G}, putting two spore counters on a Fungus you control.
Activate a Fungus by removing two spore counters from it, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing two Saprolings, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.

4067-5666.notablePrerequisites: You've paid or lost four or more {E} this turn
4067-5666.description:
Activate Izzet Generatorium by tapping it, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Izzet Generatorium.
Repeat.

628-1123-3496-4625.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to kill Dread Slaver.
628-1123-3496-4625.description:
Kill Dread Slaver.
When Dread Slaver dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Dread Slaver enters the battlefield, Flayer of the Hatebound triggers, causing Dread Slaver to deal damage to itself equal to its power.
Dread Slaver dies as a state-based action due to its deathtouch.
Dread Slaver triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

3719-4193-4605-5144.notablePrerequisites: Curse of Conformity attached to you.
3719-4193-4605-5144.description:
Cast Ephemerate by paying {W}, blinking Ruthless Technomancer.
Ruthless Technomancer and Preston trigger.
Resolve Preston's trigger, creating a 3/3 token copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
The token enters the battlefield, causing you to sacrifice the nontoken Ruthless Technomancer and create three Treasure tokens.
In response to the remaining ability, activate the token Ruthless Technomancer, paying {2}{B} and sacrificing two Treasure tokens to return Ruthless Technomancer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Ruthless Technomancer and Preston trigger.
Resolve Ruthless Technomancer's trigger, sacrificing the token Ruthless Technomancer and creating three Treasure tokens.
Resolve Preston's trigger, creating another 3/3 token copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
The token enters the battlefield, causing you to sacrifice the nontoken Ruthless Technomancer and create three additional Treasure tokens.
Repeat from step 4.
Once you have infinite Treasure tokens, you may activate Ruthless Technomancer any number of times, sacrifice the creatures you return any number of times with Ruthless Technomancer, and trigger Preston any number of times.

2615-4527-5071.notablePrerequisites:
Tree of Perdition does not have summoning sickness.
Tree of Perdition has exactly thirteen toughness.
2615-4527-5071.description:
Activate Tree of Perdition by tapping it, swapping its toughness with an opponent's life total.
Cast Comet Storm by paying {3}{R}{R}, dealing 3 damage to the opponent.
Cast Hidetsugu's Second Rite by paying {3}{R}, dealing 10 damage to the opponent.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero life.

1193-3209-4772.description:
Cast Mythos of Illuna targeting Doubling Season, creating two token copies of Doubling Season.
Cast Sprout Swarm, paying for Buyback to create eight 1/1 green Saproling creature tokens.
Cast Sprout Swarm paying for Buyback, tapping five Saprolings with convoke.
Repeat step 3.

597-1267-3395-4600-5241.notablePrerequisites:
Soltari Foot Soldier does not have summoning sickness.
Opponents can not block and kill Soltari Foot Soldier.
597-1267-3395-4600-5241.description:
Declare Soltari Foot Soldier as an attacker.
During the declare blockers phase, when you recieve priority, activate Sakashima's Student's Ninjutsu ability by paying {1}{U} and returning Soltari Foot Soldier from the battlefield to your hand, putting Sakashima's Student from your hand onto the battlefield tapped and attacking as a copy of Medomai.
Deal combat damage with Sakashima's Student, causing you to take an additional turn after this one.
Cast Soltari Foot Soldier by paying {W}.
Activate Crystal Shard by paying {U} and tapping it, returning Sakashima's Student from the battlefield to your hand.
Pass the turn.
Repeat.
